maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from mobile advertising, user acquisition and app distribution (DT Exchange, Ignite on-device), not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by advertisers and app developers, plus carriers and OEMs sharing revenue; private commercial customers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its platform and carrier/OEM partnerships; past deals like Fyber and AdColony were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers and publishers can shift ad spend or SDK partners fairly easily, though carrier/OEM on-device integrations are stickier.

notes: Carrier and OEM on-device placements may be stickier than the ad network side, so the mission-critical answer is somewhat uncertain.
